Ethereum contracts,
in Swift.

Read, simulate, and send transactions to Solidity contracts from your iOS or macOS app.

Get startedAPI reference
Swift
import SolidityBridge

let client = try EthereumClient(
    chainID: 31_337, rpcURL: rpcURL
)
let contract = client.contract(at: address, abi: abi)
let value = try await contract.read("value()")
